_readme: This file drives the Projects marquee and the detail drawer. Add a project by
appending an object to the list below and reloading. Nothing else changes.
Required:
id        a short slug, unique on the page. Used as data-project-id.
name      the title shown on the card and at the top of the drawer.
category  the first half of the small label, e.g. Kitchen.
location  the second half, e.g. New Hope.
image     path to the photograph, see imageBase below.
alt       what is actually in the frame, for screen readers.
Optional, drawer only. Any of these that are missing are simply left out:
summary   a paragraph about the project. The ones shipped here only
describe what is visible in the photograph; replace them with the
real story of the job. Falls back to alt when absent.
year      e.g. "2024". Shown as a Completed row.
scope     a list of strings, e.g. ["Full gut", "Custom cabinetry"].
Shown as a bulleted Scope of work list. Empty by default.
Images: the photographs are hosted locally in assets/portfolio/, pre-sized
as name-<width>.webp for every entry in widths. With optimizer false, an
image of "assets/portfolio/name.webp" expands to that srcset; any other
local path is used as-is with no srcset. Full size originals are kept in
assets/portfolio/originals/. Setting optimizer to true (with imageBase set
to a Next.js site) builds optimiser URLs instead. A full http(s) URL in
image is always used as-is.

projects.name: Primary Bath Remodel
projects.alt: A remodeled bathroom with a floating dark wood double vanity, stone countertop, two backlit mirrors and lighting under the cabinet.
projects.summary: A floating dark wood vanity with a stone top, twin backlit mirrors, and lighting run underneath the cabinet so the whole unit reads as though it is hovering off the wall.

projects.name: Walk-In Shower and Tile
projects.alt: A walk-in shower with a patterned mosaic feature wall, large format tile, a glass enclosure, a built in bench and a rainfall head.
projects.summary: A patterned mosaic feature wall set behind large format tile, with a frameless glass enclosure, a built in bench and a rainfall head.

projects.name: Kitchen Remodel
projects.alt: A remodeled galley kitchen with light shaker cabinets, stainless appliances, wide plank flooring and a window at the far end.
projects.summary: Light shaker cabinetry and stainless appliances down a galley plan, with wide plank flooring and the window at the far end left as the room's main source of light.

projects.name: Detached Garage
projects.alt: A finished detached garage at dusk, with a cupola on the ridge and warm light coming through the windows and door.
projects.summary: A detached garage finished with a cupola on the ridge, photographed at dusk with the windows and door lit from inside.

projects.name: New Construction Build
projects.alt: A new two storey structure going up on concrete piers, framed and partly sheathed, with the existing house alongside it.
projects.summary: A two storey structure raised on concrete piers, framed and partly sheathed, going up alongside the existing house.

projects.name: Exterior Renovation
projects.alt: A two storey home part way through an exterior renovation, wrapped in housewrap with its gables and dormers rebuilt.
projects.summary: A two storey home part way through an exterior renovation, wrapped in housewrap with its gables and dormers rebuilt.
